text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —It's Mejiro Ardan! Mejiro Ardan overtakes Oguri Cap to brilliantly take the lead—!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I managed to win, but...
as expected, Oguri-san and the others are terrifyingly strong...!
Truly the center of this era...!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ――Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That was an incredible run.
It seems I was still underestimating you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Miss, Oguri—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Good grief, can't let my guard down around you for a second.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I felt it through your running.
That sheer grit to tear everything down.
You sure showed me something amazing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Inari-san—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"The Tenno Sho (Autumn).
You'll be entering it too, of course?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's what I intend to do.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Then this time, I will be the one to win there.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Let's race, Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes—
I wouldn't have it any other way, Oguri-san.

Mejiro Ardan and Oguri Cap renew their vow to face each other once more.
And with that, the Mainichi Okan came to an end—
Later on, one evening—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (The place Yaeno-san specified should be right here, but... it seems she hasn't arrived yet.)
—Huh? Ardan-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O-san?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Why are you here, Ardan-san? Where is Yaeno-sanâ

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I see. It appears Yaeno-san called the two of us here.
—It seems you're matching.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming all this way.
I called you both here today because
there's something I wanted to give to you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Something to give me...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Right this way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Is this... a letter of challenge?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And on top of that... the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
“—In the upcoming Tenno Sho (Autumn),
Oguri-san will be competing as well.”

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: With Oguri-san, the core of the Eternal Big Three, joining us, let this race settle our score once and for all—and decide who stands at the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And...
shall we make it known to the world?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —That we are the true Big Three.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ......Heh, hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Haha, ahaha—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ardan-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Pardon me.
That was such a wonderful suggestion
that I couldn't help showing my delight.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I humbly accept this challenge.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Let us settle our score once and for all at the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...What will you do, Chiyono O?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —That goes without saying.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I accept this challenge as well!
And then... let us compete for the top!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That's what makes you worthy rivals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (At "this" very moment, I am reminded once again.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (That I truly am... a blessed soul.)
